note: Copyleft packages (GPL, LGPL, MPL) reviewed for this project's use. scripts/license-scan.mjs fails on any such package not listed here with the same license. A key ending in * covers every package whose name starts with the rest, such as a tool's per-platform binaries.

axe-core.use: Accessibility checks in the web tests only (a devDependency); never in the shipped bundle; used unmodified. MPL-2.0 is per-file copyleft, which binds only changes to its own files.

lightningcss.use: CSS processing inside Vite at build time; its code is not in the shipped bundle; used unmodified.

lightningcss-*.use: lightningcss's native binary for the build machine's platform (Linux, Windows or macOS); the same review as lightningcss.
